citations.claim: first violating step: controlled body 0 speed 12.64 while controller_force 163.22 exceeds fmax 59.98, touching body 1
one step before: body 0 already at speed 12.14 with controller_force exactly at limit 59.98 and no contact
two steps before: speed was even higher at 14.39 with force still clamped at limit

counterfactual.change: lowered controller kp from 15.687 to 1.0 only; proportional velocity-error force then stays below fmax so no violation

explanation: Controller computes force as kp * velocity-error but fails to saturate at fmax. At step 59 force is exactly at the limit (59.983). At step 60 bodies 0 and 1 collide (touching_pairs gap 0.00034) impulsively changing body 0 velocity (vy -0.27 to -2.40), increasing velocity error vs waypoint command, so raw kp*error jumps to 163.22 exceeding fmax 59.983. Lowering kp removes the exceedance, confirming unsaturated proportional law as cause.
vision_note: The red violating body stays pressed against a blue body in the upper left near the green waypoint from steps 57 to 60. At step 60 the contacting pair shows a small sudden shift while remaining touching, consistent with a collision impulse.
